newsitem.title: FINLAND: Amer suspended at own request -bourse.
newsitem.headline: Amer suspended at own request -bourse.

text.p: Trade in shares of Finnish sporting goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy was suspended on the Helsinki stock exchange at the company's own request on Monday, the bourse said.
At the stock exchange, a spokeswoman said no further information was immediately available.

Amer earlier called an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for Monday June 2. The main item on the agenda is a board proposal to convert the company's unlisted vote-strong K shares into listed A shares.
